name: Возвращение Мухтара
summary: In the most ordinary police station, young specialists investigate various crimes: from petty theft and fraud to brutal murders and daring kidnappings. The uniqueness of the team lies in the fact that Mukhtar serves together with the operatives — a brave and loyal dog, who, thanks to his excellent nose and ingenuity, helps to solve complicated cases.

name: Storied Spaces
summary: Owners transform unexpected properties into spaces that feel like home.

name: El secreto de la familia Greco
summary: Mexican remake of the Argentinian series Historia de un Clan. The Grecos, a seemingly perfect family, secretly kidnaps wealthy people for ransom to maintain their high standard of living and social status. Based on a true story.

name: 7 vs. Wild
summary: Abandoned in the wilderness, seven candidates fight for seven days to survive. Everyone has to make do with seven pre-selected objects and their clothes. Whoever is still left after seven days and has collected the most points in the daily challenges is the winner. No camera teams, no contact with the outside world, complete isolation.

name: Watch This Space
summary: The trials and tribulations of a team of workers in an advertising agency trying hard to find new ways of selling mundane products.

name: Customer Wars
summary: With supply chain shortages, prices skyrocketing and more shoplifting than ever before, positive customer relations are nearly impossible. Customer Wars spotlights the conflicts that arise when disgruntled and irrational customers come face-to-face with the employees doing their best to take care of their needs. From fiery exchanges at the fast-food drive thru to loss-prevention brawls, this series proves once and for all that "The customer is always right" is the exception rather than the rule.

name: Storm of Suspicion
summary: Follows case stories solved through forensics involving weather conditions that reveal vital evidence in solving murder crimes.

name: Nurse
summary: Mary Benjamin, a widow and supervising nurse at Grant Memorial Hospital in New York City, returns to work after her husband's death and learns to navigate life as a single woman again.

name: The Stockard Channing Show
summary: A bright, and pretty young woman named Susan Goodenow tries for a job (and gets it) as an assistant to Brad Gabriel, a consumer advocate on TV, a Bronx version of Ralph Nader.

name: Unexpected Falling
summary: Ruan Zhen Zhen has led a simple and happy life under the protection of her financial guru husband. Everything disappears in a flash after the death of her husband. Forced out of her bubble, Ruan Zhen Zhen is left to shoulder a huge amount of debt. Suddenly, lawyer Gao Jun walks into her life. Ruan Zhen Zhen may be innocent but she is not dumb. She keeps her guard up in the face of the sudden intruder and remains skeptical towards his enthusiasm to help. Will she ever open up her heart?

name: Trại Hoa Đỏ
summary: A businessman brings his fiancee and her young son to a scenic resort, and quickly finds himself embroiled in a murder investigation.

name: Брат за брата
summary: Harlem is a real ghetto in one of the major Russian cities. Here, almost openly, they sell drugs and resell stolen goods. School teachers are afraid of their students, because they are able to kill for a bad grade. Local law enforcement officers do not risk appearing on its streets late at night, and residents are so accustomed to the established rules of the game that it seems that nothing can ever make them look at what is happening around them differently.

name: Our Universe
summary: Witness the remarkable story of our universe over billions of years and its inextricable link to life on Earth in this sweeping documentary series. Narrated by Academy Award-winner Morgan Freeman, comes an epic tale 13.8 billion years in the making. Blending stunning wildlife footage with eye-popping cosmic special effects, this six-part series takes viewers on a fascinating adventure to explore the connections that drive our natural world. From the birth of the Sun to the birth of a sea turtle, Our Universe uses groundbreaking animation to dramatize the spectacular celestial forces that generated our solar system, while modern camera and CGI technology bring the audience up close and personal with some of the most iconic, charismatic animals on Earth.

name: Secretary Bai Wants to Resign Everyday
summary: Bai Jing works as a secretary for a very picky director Jin Shi An. Because of him, she not only constantly suffers at work, but also loses a boyfriend. Secretary Bai dreams of quitting, but one day, on Valentine's Day, he gets into a time loop and returns to this day every morning. Gradually, she gets closer to Director Jin and learns the truth about why he treated her so cruelly.

name: Romance and Bullets
summary: A daring college student, Yuri, is rescued from drug dealers who attacked her by a young yakuza boss, Oya Toshiomi. Despite the feelings that have arisen, the girl decides that she does not need a bad guy. But at the next meeting, young people understand that no obstacles can prevent their love. This is how their relationship begins, full of passion and danger.

name: Love Is Forbidden Here
summary: To fulfill her grandmother's wish, college student Xia Shi Cheng joins a charity tour instead of her sick twin brother. Every day she is surrounded by guys from the group, but she unexpectedly attracts the special attention of Senior Gu Lan. On the one hand, Xia Shi Cheng was busy hiding her real identity, and on the other hand, she had to deal with the problems of the group. A story about a youth full of passion and dreams, friendship and love.

name: Lipgloss Spy
summary:
Barali is a young girl dreaming of long journeys. She loves to make up and with the help of makeup can transform into anyone. Unexpectedly, she accepts the offer of a policeman friend and agrees to work undercover. She will have to go abroad, having in her arsenal only a bottomless cosmetic bag and a great desire to see the world. There they also took to meet a dream man with perfect skin, with whom she would have to cooperate side by side, and with whom she would, of course, fall in love.
Lacorn based on the novel.

name: Prism
summary: Maejima Satsuki works part time at a garden centre in Tokyo. While her aspiration is to be a voice talent, she is on the verge of giving up. Satsuki has never been serious in what she does. It is the same with romance. However, she meets Morishita Riku who is a garden designer. After a terrarium that she made captured his attention, Satsuki ends up helping out with a garden project he has undertaken. Before long, the two of them become a couple. Then the gardener Shiraishi Yuma joins the project and Riku is greatly shaken. Satsuki is unaware of their reunion. The feelings of the three of them intertwine as they focus on completing the garden. Satsuki eventually makes a choice.

name: Teen Regime
summary: A dictator or a savior? The 17-year-old prime minister designated by an AI. The year is 202X. Japan is in deep stagnation. In an attempt to overturn the situation, Prime Minister Washida launches project Utopi-AI, an experimental endeavor utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) to select leaders to govern a demoralized city. The AI's choice for the city's leader is Maki Aran, a high school boy of 17 with dreams for a utopian society. Its choices for other governing members are also in their early 20s. With this young team, Aran utilizes AI to direct reforms and turn a dispirited city into an idealistic Utopi-AI. Original screenplay by Yoshida Reiko, writer of many hit animated features.

name: Hong Kong's Fight for Freedom
summary: As a bill allowing extradition to China sparks anger in Hong Kong, four young protesters take drastic action when they realise how far the authorities will go to silence them.

name: The Two of Us
summary: The Two of Us is a US remake of the British LWT sitcom Two's Company (1975–1979). Cook plays an English butler named Brentwood, who was working for a single American mother.

name: Open All Night
summary: Open All Night centers on Gordon Feester and his oddball family working in an all-night chain grocery store named 364 Store that is open everyday except Christmas.

name: Park Place
summary: A legal-aid clinic in Manhattan full of young lawyers and their sage directors, the clinic took cases based on a "take a number" method.

name: Country Music Awards Highlights
summary: BBC Radio 2's Bob Harris introduces highlights from 'Country Music's Biggest Night'.

name: Targeted for Murder
summary: Targeted for Murder is a true crime series that explores murder committed using the world's deadliest weapons: guns. Each episode presents one story of murder by way of the gun, using gripping interviews, dramatic re-enactments and archival footage. Gun experts, psychologists and former law enforcement officers tell these stories and help the view understand the psychology behind the crime. Actual police crime scene and interrogation footage provide further insight into the murders, and forensic experts explain the particular gun used in each shooting and the science behind matching bullets found at the crime scene with that gun. Every episode explains the forensics that were used to convict the killer(s) as well as dig into their psychological profile.

name: Making the Most of the Micro
summary: Ian McNaught-Davis presents a studio based prog on micro computers - how they are used and how to use one.

previousepisode.name: At the End of the Line

name: Three-Body
summary:
Adapted from the novel "The Three-Body Problem" (三体) by Liu Ci Xin (刘慈欣).
A nanomaterials expert sees a mysterious countdown superimposed in his field of vision and finds himself under military investigation. To unravel the mystery, he enters the VR game "Three-Body" developed by a secret organization ETO and discovers the truth behind the deaths of dozens of scientists and a tragedy from the days of the Cultural Revolution.

name: Barom One
summary: Takeshi Kido and Kentaro Shiratori are a pair of friends who have been together for almost their entire life. One night, a monstrous being comes out from the lake and starts attacking them. When Takeshi and Kentaro are almost eliminated, a strange being named Kopu calls them and tells them that they are the chosen ones to inherit the power to protect the world from an evil being named Goumon. Now, they join their hands to transform into Barom One, a being with superior skills, who will fight to protect the city.

name: Goodnight, Beantown
summary: Matt Cassidy and Jennifer Barnes are two news anchors at a fictional Boston, Massachusetts television station. Matt is a longtime fixture at station WYN-TV where he anchors the evening news broadcasts, but when the ratings for his news broadcast begin to slide, the station management pairs the reluctant anchor with a female co-anchor, Jennifer.

name: The Renegades
summary: An updated version of The Mod Squad. The Renegades are a street gang that's been given a choice of (A) Go to jail for the commission of various gang-related crimes, or (B) go to work for the police as a special undercover unit. Being clever kids, they choose (B).

name: Phantom School
summary: Nestled quietly in the heart of a buzzing community, there sits a school that to any who might pass it by, appears to be quite normal. However, as is often the case, looks can be quite deceiving. Inhabited by several malicious phantoms, this school plays host to more than its dedicated faculty and lively student body. While most of the students at this school are largely unaware of the otherworldly beings who exist beside them, some are easily swayed by the phantom's presence. For those who are easily manipulated by the specters, life has a way of quickly becoming a living nightmare as they're forced to give in to the evil desires of their ghastly tormentors. But even as some students are swayed by the phantoms, others have taken on the role of a hunter and have accepted the responsibility of fighting against them. One such hunter, Lee Do Gyeom, has dedicated his life to this task. As a student currently enrolled in this phantom school, it's up to him to save those afflicted by the evil which haunts its halls. But does he have the strength to take on this malicious force alone?

name: The Lesbian Bar Project
summary: This 3 part series spotlights the heartfelt, hilarious, and human stories behind the few remaining Lesbian Bars in the United States.

name: Rolf Harris: Hiding in Plain Sight
summary: Rolf Harris: Hiding in Plain Sight will examine the shocking truth behind how former national treasure Rolf Harris betrayed the trust of the nation and hid in plain sight whilst sexually abusing children and young women for years.

name: Boris Becker: The Rise and Fall
summary: Boris Becker: The Rise and Fall is a story of greed, egotism, arrogance and chronic sexual infidelity.  Above all, it's the story of the destructive power of fame. The series will reveal the untold, inside story of how one of the world's greatest sporting stars ended up in Wandsworth Jail.

name: The Real Crown: Inside the House of Windsor
summary:
The behind the scenes story of the world's most famous family is told through the  perspective of the major personal challenges that faced the Queen and the monarchy throughout her reign.

Rare archive footage is set against revealing new interviews with key figures - some of whom have never previously spoken on camera - to compelling effect as viewers see the images played out to the world during historic moments, while hearing the inside story offering insight into The Queen's perspective at the time.

name: A Murder in the Family
summary: A Murder in the Family will show, in some family's lives, behind the veil of smiling social media posts and daily texts, a true horror story is brewing.  These murders aren't ‘crimes of passion' but premeditated acts of control or revenge, leaving behind a family blown apart.

name: Laura Whitmore Investigates
summary: Laura Whitmore takes on a series of controversial issues, which will see her using her journalism skills to reveal new insights on each subject. Viewers will see a new side of Laura as she travels within the UK and further afield to delve into subjects that fascinate her and have an impact on our lives.

name: My Mum, Your Dad
summary: Kate Langbroek presents this heartfelt series about single parents looking for love. What they don't know is their adult children are secretly guiding them through the perils of dating.

name: Nattryttarna
summary: This is a survival thriller, based on true events, three women with different connections to one man needs to find a way to get out of the monsters grip. Will they be believed or can he manipulate the surroundings once again.

name: Kaidanshita no Gogh
summary: Miyako is a beautiful salesperson on the fast track at a major cosmetics company earning more than 100 grand a year. But when she begins to question her life, she drops everything to pursue a past dream to become a painter. At a cram school for getting into an art institute, she meets a cute yet younger painter with prodigious artistic talent, but he's also a penniless jerk. Can Miyako capture both her dream and romance in this newfangled rich-woman-poor-man love story?

name: Bullyparade
summary: Michael "Bully" Herbig and his two colleagues Christian Tramitz and Rick Kavanian shine in this sketch parade in countless roles and masks. Whether as the Austrian imperial couple Sissi and Franz(i) or as the gay crew of a spaceship - the parodies offer unimagined opportunities for punchlines of all kinds. Classics like "Gossip Café with Dimitri" or the Czech TV talk show with Pavel and Bronko skilfully make fun of alleged foreign idiosyncrasies.

name: Kurosagi
summary: The stage is set in Japan in the year 2022. In a time where fraud is an imminent threat, societal issues give rise to a slew of elaborate scams. Kurosaki is a man who lost his family to a "white swindler," which is a professional swindler who scams people out of their money. In order to exact revenge, Kurosaki becomes a "black swindler," a swindler who tricks other swindlers. He swears to scam every white swindler in the world and takes on foe after foe, but can he find his ultimate enemy who robbed him of his family? This riveting revenge drama exposes the very emotions that scams exploit.

name: Aamel Eih
summary: Dramedy about Abdullah, the sound engineer on radio with his four daughters and stubborn wife.

name: Spooky
summary: Spooky explores the supernatural as these outstanding screenplays venture into the dark corners of the imagination to create some of the most spine-tingling scenes ever seen on children's television!

previousepisode.name: # # The Fall Of The House Of Franklyn

name: Street Alcohol Fighter
summary: A variety show where Kim Hee Chul invites guests out for a drink.

name: Наследники и самозванцы
summary: 18 stars of Russian show business will challenge each other and their own fears. The project, hosted by Laysan Utyasheva, will take viewers into the space of a luxurious castle and combine several world-famous formats.

name: Город ромашек
summary: Once Nadia and Andrey loved each other and dreamed of getting married. Did not work out. Years have passed. Andrei is now a popular Moscow actor, and the story of his love with a girl from the city of Romashkina was promoted in the media. One day Andrew gets into a serious trouble. To avoid major troubles, he urgently needs to get married, and there is no better candidate for Nadia. But Nadia does not want to participate in this show. In an attempt to win her heart again, Andrei helps care for her charges (Nadia is a social worker). One day, looking for her nephew at the request of an old woman, Nadia and Andrey find two corpses in the garage. The police consider it a double suicide, but Andrei, who has been playing cops for many years, finds important evidence that clearly points to a murder.

name: Healing Food, Healing Love
summary:
Tells the love story between Shen Ying and Zheng Dao - two very different people in terms of personality and profession. But they both have two things in common: the same interests and goals, they want to share with the world all kinds of useful delicacies.
Shen Ying is the culinary editor of the magazine, she is an independent and hardworking person, beautiful and kind to others. Zheng Dao is the special director of Gourmet Edition magazine, he has a cold and arrogant character. He is very principled and picky in business, and he also has very strict requirements for food.

name: Синдикат
summary: When law enforcement agencies encounter the activities of an underground octopus syndicate, the idea arises of introducing two agents into its ranks. Each of them has its own mission. They disappear to the outside world: they change names, erase their biographies, renounce the people they valued. Agents do not know about the existence of each other, communication with the Center and the outside world is carried out through the Curator.

name: Без прикрытия
summary: The plot of the project is based on the story of two twin brothers. One is the first-class thief Bogdan Volny, who loves freedom and lives according to the rules. And the second, Grigory, is a police operative. The career did not work out, colleagues push them around, "friends" throw money at them, and the crime that Grisha has to fight against is not at all afraid of him.

name: Universal Basic Guys
summary: In Universal Basic Guys brothers Mark and Hank Hoagies suddenly find themselves with no jobs when the Glantontown Hot Dog factory switches over to automation. Lucky for them, the town started a radical Universal Basic Income pilot program, giving all residents of Glantontown $3,000 per month with no strings attached. Now, Mark, Hank and the rest of their local buddies are once again kids in the summertime, overflowing with the perilous combo of free time and stupid ideas. This is a show about men trying to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed.

name: Ukraїner на карантині
summary: Special project about how Ukraine is experiencing quarantine.

name: Ukraine from above. Expeditions Ukraїner
summary: In these videos, you can see the main locations of Ukraїner aerial photography expeditions. Little-known locations and fantastic nature.

previousepisode.name: Україна, якою ви її не знали

name: Голодомор
summary: From July to September 2020, the Holodomor Museum and Ukraїner carried out a large-scale expedition to Ukraine in search of Holodomor witnesses. The team visited 64 settlements in 33 districts, where they recorded the testimonies of 120 eyewitnesses of the Holodomor, talked to 50 local historians and discovered 66 mass graves for victims of genocide. The project, implemented with the support of the Ukrainian Cultural Foundation, is called "The Holodomor: Mosaics of History."

name: Рідний Крим
summary:
Since the beginning of the Russian occupation of Crimea, about 45,000 Crimean people, including many Crimean Tatars, have left for mainland Ukraine. The Russian occupation authorities are actively persecuting Crimean Tatars on ethnic grounds. Over the years of occupation, many cases of kidnapping, missing people, house searches, arrests, and torture of members of the Crimean Tatar community have been recorded. Crimean Tatars have been unable to return safely to their homeland for 7 years.

In the series created jointly with the Ukrainian Institute, the heroes in VR glasses look at sights in Crimea that are important to them, and share their memories and memorable stories about their native peninsula.

name: Історія за 1 хвилину
summary: Stories about people and places of Ukraine in one minute.

name: Країна ззовні
summary: This series is not about successful immigration but about people who had moved abroad for different reasons and started helping Ukraine in various ways: creating state-to-state projects, sharing experiences obtained abroad, uniting in Ukrainian communities and spreading Ukrainian culture all over the world.

name: Хоробрі міста
summary: "Brave cities" is a series of short videos about Ukrainian cities under temporary Russian occupation and heroically resisting.

previousepisode.name: Фільм «Хоробрі міста»: нова українська музика спротиву

name: Меми війни. Як росіяни ганьбляться в Україні
summary: War memes. How Russians disgrace themselves in Ukraine.

previousepisode.name: Меми року: жарти, які допомагали триматися

name: Деокупація. Експедиція звільненими регіонами
summary: Ukrainians do not surrender and do not surrender their cities and villages to the Russian invaders. Residents of the settlements, which were under temporary occupation, are bravely resisting. The Ukraїner team went on an expedition through the already liberated territories to record incredible stories of resistance and modern partisanship.

previousepisode.name: Бої на бахмутському напрямку та звільнення Кліщіївки

name: 609 Bedtime Story
summary: One day, Mum, a playboy and the landlord of Room 609, saw a young man in his bed. Ever since the day they first met and slept, mysterious things have been happening. Mum kept dreaming about a mysterious event and would be suddenly woken up in the middle of the night by those strange dreams. Mum tried to forget his 'feelings' toward the young man by sleeping with women. However, it only made him think even more often of the man of his dreams. He then connected every detail and came up with the theory of reverse parallel universes. Eventually, he met Dew in real life. Although it was Dew's last day when they first met, it was also the beginning of them helping each other change the future!

name: Travelling Man
summary: Alan Lomax is an ex-police detective who has just spent two years in prison on a trumped-up bribery charge. On his release, Lomax takes to the canals of England in a narrowboat to track down those responsible for betraying him.

name: Castle Howard: Through the Seasons
summary: A behind-the-scenes look at the iconic national treasure, revealing the fascinating and varied activities at the stately home, from the first drops of spring through to a magical Christmas.

name: Italia 90: Four Weeks That Changed the World
summary:
Told by an international roster of iconic interviewees, including Paul Gascoigne, John Barnes, Terry Butcher, Jürgen Klinsmann, Lothar Matthäus, Salvatore ‘Toto' Schillaci, Roger Milla and Dragan Stojković, Italia 90: Four Weeks that Changed the World is the definitive story of the World Cup that forever changed football and so much more.

Following the journey of five of the most memorable teams – England, Italy, Cameroon, Yugoslavia, and the Italia 90 World Cup Winners West Germany - this three-part documentary will combine edge–of-the-seat drama on the pitch with the momentous historical shifts that were happening beyond it. From the fall of the Berlin Wall to the civil wars of Yugoslavia; English hooliganism of the 1980s to the rise of a new culture of football in the 1990s, we will discover how Italia 90 was a tournament played in the crucible of a changing world.

name: Il Grande Gioco
summary:
Billionaire deals, ruthless characters, dream locations and nail-biting negotiations, the football transfer market is one of the most exciting moments in the entire football season and this dramatization delves behind-the-scenes of the dark and glamorous market through the eyes of protagonist, Corso Manni.

Discredited by false accusations, Corso has gone from being the golden boy of ISG, Italy's largest football agents' company, to a pariah. With the help of young agent Marco Assari, Corso begins to rebuild his career by competing against his ex-wife Elena De Gregorio and her father Dino De Gregorio, for the lucrative signing of football champion Quintana and young talent Antonio Lagioia.

An unexpected game of alliances and betrayals takes shape with the arrival on the scene of Sasha Kirillov, an experienced agent of the Russian company Plustar, who is determined to win the Italian football market and the prestigious signings held by ISG.

name: Joan
summary:
Joan is inspired by the true story of notorious jewel thief, Joan Hannington.

Joan, a fiery and uncompromising woman in her twenties who is deeply scarred and vulnerable, is a devoted mother to her six-year-old daughter Kelly but is trapped in a disastrous marriage with a violent criminal named Gary. When Gary goes on the run, Joan seizes the opportunity to create a new life for herself and her daughter.

Adopting new identities and making new acquaintances along the way, Joan becomes a masterful jewel thief - she embarks on a thrilling and highstakes journey that challenges her every limit while driven by her desire to care for her daughter and create a secure home for them both.

name: Foley Square
summary: A Manhattan ADA's professional life is complicated by personal problems in this good-natured take on love and the legal world.

name: Robo Mundial
summary: After investing all his savings to travel with his son to the World Cup, Lucho is shocked when he learns that the Argentine team gets disqualified from the games. He and a handful of his co-workers, a flashy group of losers about to lose their jobs, decide to take "justice into their own hands", so they devise a plan to steal the celebrated World Cup trophy during its promotional tour of Argentina. This way, the national team could rejoin the games, and he and his son could travel to World Cup as originally planned.

name: Medical Examiner Dr. Qin: The Mind Reader
summary: After the mysterious death of his mother, forensic science grad student, Qin Ming, travels to his mother's hometown to investigate. Arriving in Longfan City earlier than anticipated, Qin Ming soon finds himself inadvertently involved in an entirely different murder case. Now working two cases at once, Qin Min has no choice but to seek the help of the local authorities, the only problem is, Qin Min has a horrible time trying to communicate with others. Doing his best to overcome his difficulties with communication, Qin Min soon finds himself working with a number of forensic doctors and police officers, including An Ran, Lin Tao, and Huan Huan. Working closely with this team of professionals, the barrier between them steadily crumbles as his outstanding professionalism and undeniable skill easily win them over.  Earning his team's love and respect, the group work tirelessly to get to the bottom of this grisly pair of murders but as they draw closer to solving the cases, a number of shocking truths are revealed. Will Qin Ming and his team be able to handle the secrets they're about to uncover?

name: Hail to the Chief
summary: After being elected the first female president, Julia Mansfield must try to balance her political career with raising her family.

name: Ueinig
summary: Ingunn Solheim wants us to get better at disagreeing. Can she help the different sides in polarized debates find common ground?

name: Çekiç ve Gül: Bir Behzat Ç. Hikayesi
summary: After graduating from the Police Academy in 1985, Behzat starts working in the Ankara Police Department Murder Bureau. He is fearless, intelligent, strong and charismatic. Behzat remains a detective, while all his colleagues move to higher positions. Although he always gets into trouble, he has his own methods of catching criminals. He is constantly referred to the disciplinary committee, but will never change. Behzat does not trust anyone, especially women.. Behzat does not follow the rules, he creates his own rules.

name: Neon
summary: An aspiring reggaeton star and his best friends move to Miami, weathering roadblocks and reality checks together in their quest for success.

name: Olga Da Polga
summary: The adventures of Michael Bond's loveable guinea pig heroine Olga da Polga and her animal friends come to life in this funny, colourful and heartwarming live action series.

name: Teeny Tiny Creatures
summary: Teeny Tiny Creatures sees animal experts help children understand the tiniest creatures.

name: MOTD World Cup Top 10
summary: Gary, Alan and Micah debate the greatest players, teams and goals in World Cup history.

previousepisode.name: Alan and Micah's All-Time World Cup XI

name: Late Night Football Club
summary: Robbie Savage hosts a World Cup party for Wales alongside Jonny Owen and Polly James.

name: Stuff the British Stole
summary: Follow Marc Fennell on a globe-trotting, emotional quest for the truth as he unravels the twisted mysteries behind six iconic and priceless objects taken by the British Empire and meets those who want them back.

name: LIDO TV
summary: Created and hosted by Grammy-nominated artist Lido Pimienta, LIDO TV is a variety show filled with unhinged sketches, interviews, music and documentaries that cover timely topics with humour and heart.

name: Golf: World Tour Championships
summary: The top golfers on the European Tour battle it out for a prize fund of $8 million in the final tournament of the season.

name: The New Wave of Standup
summary: The New Wave of Standup features rising Canadian comics who bring their diverse backgrounds, viewpoints and unique comedy styles to the stage in 10-minute sets.

name: What Happened That Night
summary: When the man she is having an affair with dies in her home, the wife Rasha is forced to hide his body from her husband and resort to ways that put her vulnerable to blackmail and fear.

name: Our Family Honor
summary: Our Family Honor is about two New York City families who had known each other since their childhoods and who were involved in competing "family businesses". The McKay family mostly worked for the New York City Police Department, where Patrick (Kenneth McMillan) was Commissioner, while the Danzigs were deeply involved in organized crime, with patriarch Vincent (Eli Wallach) filling the role of "godfather".

name: Secret Restoration
summary: Inside a century-old tool factory in New England, a group of the nation's top restorers and craftsmen have come together to make dreams come true. They repair and restore family heirlooms and precious items in secret, and then reveal them to unsuspecting recipients. Each episode of Secret Restoration will unearth surprising history, hidden details, and bring to life people's most treasured possessions.

name: La grosse émission best of 2022
summary: This show, created by Dominique Farrugia in 1997 and broadcast live five times a week until 2002, uses the principle of American comedy talk shows. The presenter, who changes every two months, sits at a desk on the stage of the Comedy Theater and addresses his guest to entertain the audience and viewers.

name: Agatha Christie: Lucy Worsley on the Mystery Queen
summary: A life as dramatic as her work. Lucy Worsley discovers the origins of Agatha Christie's macabre magic - and with some compelling characters, uncovers carefully concealed secrets.

name: In Pursuit with John Walsh: Captured
summary: John and Callahan Walsh celebrate the captures from investigations that left the largest impacts. With the perps finally behind bars, families can breathe easier knowing that justice has been served.

name: Cooks on Fire
summary: Who will be crowned NZ's best BBQ team and win $30,000 in prize money? Host Ganesh Raj is joined by pitmaster Jared Macdonald and internationally renowned fire expert and meat scientist Jess Pryles in the ultimate barbecue battle.

name: Forever
summary: Reunited as teens, two childhood friends fall deeply in love, experiencing the joy and heartache of a first romance that will change their lives forever.

name: Seconds
summary: Based on the novel by David Ely, Seconds is a radical reimagining of the 1966 cult classic with a female lead at its center. When Claire Munro's world is suddenly turned upside down, she's given a chance to start life over with a clean slate. But can she really leave everything behind, or will she find herself diving back into the mysteries of her past?

name: Good Night, and Good Luck
summary: Good Night, and Good Luck is a small screen adaptation of the 2005 feature film directed by and starring George Clooney. The series is an origin story of the conflict centered around the newsmen and women who worked alongside CBS journalist Edward R. Murrow amid a post-war climate of fear and hysteria. It follows Sy Steingartner, a young cameraman for Murrow's See It Now, who is forced to juggle his admiration for Murrow with his own ambition. With the CBS brass pushing an anti-Communist Loyalty Oath on Murrow and his staff, Steingartner has an opportunity to rise straight to the top, but only by betraying his mentor in the process. With wit and keen observation, the series confronts how we respond to chaos and the values that pull us through.

name: Sacked in the Morning
summary: From transfer windows to formations, from man-management to getting the sack. Craig Levein and Amy Irons explore what it takes to survive as a football manager.

name: Duckrockers
summary: In the fresh, funny and heart-warming prequel to Sione's Wedding, Pacific Island teenagers and best friends Michael, Albert, Sefa and Stan come of age in inner-city Auckland in 1984. Made with the support of NZ On Air.

name: America's Psychic Challenge
summary: Lifetime's new reality competition features 16 unique individuals from across the country who claim to have the gift of clairvoyance. They're going to battle it out for the coveted title of America's #1 Psychic.

name: Jack and Mike
summary: Newspaper columnist Jackie Shea (Shelley Hack) and restaurateur Mike Brennan (Tom Mason) foster a modern marriage in Chicago.

name: Tribeca
summary: Tribeca was an hour-long anthology that, despite widespread critical acclaim, ran only for seven original episodes. It was co-produced, with much fanfare, by Oscar-winning actor Robert DeNiro. The show's namesake, of course is the Manhattan neighborhood "Triangle Below Canal." Only actor/director Joe Morton ("Brother from Another Planet") and Philip Bosco were regulars. The theme song, which sampled James Brown's voice, was performed by hip-hop artist Me Phi Me.

name: Edge of Normal
summary: Six teenage girls that posses extraordinary, mysterious and dangerous powers, struggle to grow up in a world where their mistakes have deadly repercussions.

name: Brutally Honest
summary: Brutally Honest is a comedy about how having a baby can ruin, save, change, destroy and inspire your marriage… all before lunch.

name: Super Sleuths
summary: Super Sleuths examines the script to screen journeys of six of ITV's premier detectives. In the company of cast and crew, literary experts and aficionados we trace the literary origins of; Inspector Morse, Wycliffe, Jack Frost, Poirot, Inspector Barnaby and Inspector Wexford.

name: Shackleton
summary: Having had a taste of Antarctic adventure on Captain Scott's failed 1901 bid to reach the South Pole, seven years later Ernest Shackleton leads his own expedition. Agonisingly close to reaching the Pole, the men have to pull back in an appalling blizzard to reach their ship before the advancing ice cuts off the passage home. By 1911 Roald Amundsen has reached the Pole and Scott and his men, trailing in the Norwegian's wake, have perished. Undeterred, in 1914 Shackleton and his trusted deputy Frank Wild set out on their most famous journey aboard Endurance, with the aim of crossing the icy continent from sea to sea.

name: Los Montaner
summary: The Montaner family: meet and follow this iconic family, headed by one of the most important artists in Latin music's history: Ricardo Montaner. This family of artists has become one of the most successful and talked about in the entertainment business. Get a peek at their daily lives as they balance family and professional life under the public eye.

name: La Ruta
summary: La Ruta is the journey of a group of friends from El Perelló, from their farewell in a crowded Ruta Destroy, in 1993, until the day they entered Barraca for the first time, in 1981, when both they and "the party" they still preserved their innocence. La Ruta recounts the more than ten years that Valencia spent dancing, a few years that we would all like to live and that only a few can remember.

name: Gränsbevakarna Sverige
summary: Thousands of people cross Sweden's borders every day. We follow customs officers, investigators, scouts and dog handlers who daily secure Sweden's borders, ports and airports.

name: Socho Shihatsu no Sappukei
summary: Based on collection of short stories "Socho Shihatsu no Sappukei" by Yugo Aosaki

name: Food Affair with Mark Wiens
summary: Focus on the history and stories behind Singapore's hawker and fine dining scene. Considering that Singapore currently has over 50 Michelin-starred establishments and over 60 Bib Gourmand spots, it is really a playground for the adventurous and hungry.

name: The Victory Garden
summary:
The Victory Garden is an American public television program about gardening and other outdoor activities, which was produced by station WGBH-TV in Boston, Massachusetts, and distributed by PBS. It was the oldest gardening program produced for television in the United States, premiering April 16, 1975.
The show was originally called Crockett's Victory Garden for its first host, James Underwood Crockett. On each episode, Crockett demonstrates and cares for a vegetable, fruit, and flower garden, shows you how to build a cold frame, and why salt marsh hay was useful as a mulch. At the end of each episode, Crockett was in the greenhouse, as he answered viewer questions about gardening, which were sent in by viewers. Following Crockett's death at the age of 63, Bob Thomson hosted the program from 1979 to 1991 and the show was renamed The Victory Garden. With Thomson at the helm, The Victory Garden began to broaden its scope. In addition to the regular gardening demonstrations, the show began to make room for more guests and travel features. Marian Morash, wife of series producer Russell Morash, appeared on the air to do her recipes on the program from 1979 to 2001.

Roger Swain hosted the program from 1991 to 2002, Michael Weishan hosted the program from 2002 to 2007. Jamie Durie hosted the program from 2007 to 2010. In 2013, the show was relaunched in partnership with Edible Communities, and it became The Victory Garden's EdibleFeast. It was produced for two seasons.

name: Battle of the Bling
summary: Battle of the Bling follows Todrick and Kim as they tour 15 strikingly properties nominated by their owners as the most ostentatious.

previousepisode.name: Who's the Blingiest of Them All?

name: Dangerous Breed: Crime. Cons. Cats.
summary: A filmmaker spends years documenting controversial wrestler and cat breeder Teddy Hart, but the project is thrown into chaos when Teddy is accused of wrongdoing; as Teddy defends himself, his protégé and ex-girlfriend Samantha Fiddler disappears.

name: The Tetris Murders
summary: On September 22, 1998, Vladimir Pokhilko, who was involved with the development of TETRIS, was found dead alongside his wife and their young son in their Palo Alto, California, home. Now, more than two decades later, the Palo Alto Police Department homicide investigators who were first on the scene revisit the haunting crime. What was once thought to be a murder-suicide in 1998 is now revealed to be something much more sinister.

name: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
summary: The Bermuda Triangle is the most notorious stretch of ocean in history, evoking fear and endless fascination. Bounded by Florida, Bermuda and Puerto Rico, these waters have swallowed countless ships and planes and their crews—some vanishing without a trace.

name: El Club de los Graves
summary:
El Club de los Graves follows the story of Amaranto Molina, an unconventional music teacher who starts teaching at a music school that only encourages students who do well by commercial success standards. Every year Principal Eduardo Kramer, chooses five students, nicknamed Los Agudos, to be part of the school's prestigious Teen Band. Molina, on the other hand, is put in charge of Los Graves, a group of students whose talents do not meet the school's standards. 

With his disruptive methods, this eccentric teacher and Los Graves will embark on a music journey that will help heal wounds and inspire each one of them to express their unique talents. Along the way, the students will learn more about Mr. Molina and discover their teacher's mysterious hidden past.

name: LEGO Friends Heartlake Stories
summary: Big-hearted friends go on adventures.

name: Project Alpha
summary: Alpha is the strongest wolf while the remaining wolves in the pack are called Beta. Get ready for a heated survival reality contest where the next GMMTV idols make their debut. 24 Betas will be fighting to survive and 4 Alphas will be competing for the top spot, overcoming tough challenges set by nationally recognized judges. Fight alongside these 28 trainees in Project Alpha.

name: And We Danced
summary: The Australian Ballet has evolved to become our nation's most treasured performing arts company and an icon of dance. And We Danced looks back to reveal what has shaped this world-class institution and made it uniquely ours.

name: Reddet
summary: We follow the rescue helicopter service in Norway and get a unique insight into some of the most spectacular rescue operations in the country.

name: Donna Hay Christmas
summary: Donna Hay shows us how to create the most spectacular festive celebration in her new four-part series, Donna Hay Christmas. From reimagined festive mains like the ultimate glazed ham, to showstopping desserts like her signature centerpiece pavlova, Donna shares her best time-savers and signature cheats to create your very own kind of Christmas magic.

name: Thank You Doctor
summary: A story that follows doctors of the newly-established EICU who rely on their medical expertise to save every patient. Overcoming differences, they pour their hearts and soul into preserving life. Returning from abroad, Xiao Yan carries the pains of having lost her fiancee as she arrives at Tongshan Hospital. Despite being gruff and tough on the outside, Xiao Yan is remarkably meticulous on the operating table as she conducts surgeries with machine precision. Once the high and mighty doctor, Bai Zhu adopts a terminal patient and starts to believe in finding hope in the most desperate situations. Through their daily interactions, two people who have their own convictions and preconceived judgments towards one another gradually come to accept each other as they discover many things in common.

name: A Grito Herido
summary: Five close childhood friends try to leave behind the problems that separated them for 7 years and resume an old musical dream while together they search for love, their calling and a very elusive happiness.

previousepisode.name: The Savior is a Fourth Grader

name: Slinger's Day
summary: Cecil Slinger is the manager of Supafare, a small London supermarket. He's not the best man for the job - but then neither are his useless staff.

name: The Redd Foxx Show
summary: The adventures of an eccentric New York City coffee shop and newsstand proprietor.

name: One Big Family
summary: After the deaths of his brother and sister-in-law, an ex-vaudevillian moves in with their five kids, ranging in age from 8 to 23.

name: Joakims første porno
summary: In this personal and boundary-breaking documentary series, Joakim Kleven goes head-to-head into a disgraced porn industry, and at the same time looks at how it affects Norwegian youth.

name: The World About Us
summary: The World About Us is a series of documentaries from all over the world about our astonishing planet and the creatures that live on it.

name: Rehab Addict Lake House Rescue
summary: Nicole Curtis is back and ready to finish the epic renovation of a historic lake cottage she started nearly a decade ago. She takes restoration to new heights as she lifts and expands her way to turning the tiny home into the grandest house on the lake.

name: Steve Donovan, Western Marshall
summary: Steve Donovan, Western Marshall is a horse opera of an older era. The hero, Steve Donovan, played by Douglas Kennedy, is of an older generation. His inevitable sidekick, Rusty (pestered by a bum sacroiliac, naturally) is twice as old as Steve.

name: Белая гвардия
summary: The film tells about the arduous years of the civil war in Russia, portraying the fate of the Turbin family who fell into a cycle of sad events of the 1918-1919 winter in Kiev. The basis for the film's plot is the eponymous novel by Mikhail Bulgakov and is based on fight for control over Kiev during Russian Civil War.

name: A Thousand Goodnights
summary: To carry out her dad's wish and discover her roots, Dai Tian-qing embarks on a journey around Taiwan and finds love and redemption on the way.

name: The Lenny Henry Show
summary: The Lenny Henry Show is based on the attempts of 'wicked' and 'crucial' south London pirate radio DJ Delbert Wilkins to break into the big time.

name: I Have a Song I Want You to Hear
summary: When we were 17  we looked at our teacher who was 27 with arrogance but time flies and before we knew it, we were 27 too. We didn't know how hard life could be 10 years later. We didn't know we would meet each other and our teacher again in that future.

name: I Married Dora
summary: Los Angeles architect and single father Peter Farrell was dependent upon his housekeeper Dora Calderon. However, she was an undocumented immigrant from El Salvador and the United States government's Immigration and Naturalization Service was about to deport her. To prevent her from being arrested upon her return home, and to be able to continue to employ her services as a housekeeper, the two married.

name: Please Love Me
summary: Male model Chen Yi Chuan fell in love at first sight with a domineering girl Mai Tong. But he never expected that she would be so indifferent to him. However, Chen Yi Chuan is not going to give up.

name: Shelved
summary: Follows the employees and patrons of Jameson Public Library as they go about their lives in this unassuming and extraordinary place.

name: Good Rivals
summary: Experience the rise of the US Men's National Team through their decades long rivalry with the Mexico Men's National Team. The series peels back the political, social, and sporting layers of the rivalry through the eyes of Landon Donovan (US) and Rafael Márquez (MX), who became symbols of their countries' soccer cultures.

name: Heartland Homicide
summary: We all dream of possessing a part of that quaint small-town life. A friendly smile and wave from the neighbors as the kids run through the yards playing ball. Unfortunately, sometimes even paradise is visited by loss. Heartland Homicide tells the stories of these events, when big city crimes visit small-town America. Each episode uncovers the lives and circumstances of the victims while outlining and examining the convicted individual's motives, bringing the horrific events into the light with the people who were there.

name: Secrets, Lies and DNA Ties
summary: When questions about familial genealogy arise, it's up to two diligent and sophisticated owners of the company DNA Confidential to unearth the Secrets, Lies and DNA Ties among their clients in order to get the answers needed.

name: The Spencer Sisters
summary: In The Spencer Sisters, after a string of bad luck, Toronto police officer Darby Spencer quits her job and is forced to return home to her estranged mother, internationally renowned mystery novelist Victoria Spencer. After the duo are thrust into solving a crime together, Darby discovers a side to Victoria she never knew, and ultimately takes the plunge into the unlikeliest of ventures: becoming her partner in a private detective agency. Despite their opposing personalities, generational differences and complicated history, they discover they may have more in common than they thought. Each episode brings a new case to solve, and while the tightly-wound Darby and the carefree Victoria may never quite see eye to eye, they discover that maybe – just maybe – they need each other more than they realize.

name: Life on Our Planet
summary: Life's extraordinary journey to conquer, adapt and survive on Earth across billions of years comes alive in this groundbreaking nature docuseries.

previousepisode.name: Chapter 8: Age of Ice and Fire

name: Back in the Groove
summary: Back in the Groove follows three women who will check into a resort on an island of the Dominican Republic to rediscover their youth, live joyously, and find love with men half their age.

name: Down Home Fab
summary: Chelsea and Cole DeBoer of Teen Mom 2 fame will begin the next chapter of their on-screen careers as HGTV's latest dream team in the network's new series Down Home Fab. Premiering Monday, Jan. 16, at 9 p.m. ET/PT and also available to stream the same day on discovery+, the six hour-long episodes will spotlight the couple's burgeoning renovation business in their hometown of Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Chelsea's bold vision will punch up each design plan, while Cole will serve as the hands-on project manager and jack-of-all-trades. Throughout the series, fans will get a glimpse of their busy family life raising four children on a beautiful Midwestern farm with sweeping views and lots of animals.

name: Wall of Bakers
summary: Wall of Bakers challenges contestants to take on a different panel of tough judges drawn from the culinary world.

name: Home Sweet Rome
summary: Follows Lucy, who moves from California to start a new life in Rome with her dad and stepmom, Francesca, an Italian pop star.

name: Next Level Chef
summary:
Next Level Chef is set in an iconic and trailblazing TV studio like no other, with three unique kitchen spaces set across three storeys and almost 50ft high.

Each floor will test the contestants' culinary creativity, agility, flare, and expertise, as they vie to progress to the Next Level. From the top-level state of the art kitchen utopia to the gloomy basement level ‘scraps only' surroundings, Next Level Chef will task its chefs to prove they can thrive in any environment.

name: Planet Sex with Cara Delevingne
summary: On this immersive journey, Cara Delevingne puts her mind and body on the line in search of answers regarding human sexuality, its joys, mysteries, and constantly changing nature. In every episode, she shares her own personal experiences. Uniquely unfiltered and authentic, there's no limit on how far Cara's willing to go to explore what makes us all human.

name: Strut
summary: Eddie is a geeky porn editor whose low self-confidence has turned her into a 26-year-old hermit. Her friends, Eva (an unemployed artist), Lucy (an intern), and Chandaleer (a trainwreck/fashion model) vow to save her from her unhealthy solitude. When the friends decide to start a high-end escorting agency to earn more money, they convince skeptical Eddie to help them build their business and lift her self-esteem. Together they successfully navigate the adrenaline-fueled escorting industry with Eddie as their CEO and fellow sex worker.

name: Drawtectives
summary: York, Grendan, and Rosé are on a mission to solve the mysterious Murder at Crescent Hill, one drawing at a time.

name: Bettany Hughes Voices of the Dead
summary: A forensic dig into history's most enduring mysteries. In Voices of the Dead, Professor Bettany Hughes leads a forensic investigation into some of the most enduring mysteries of the ancient world and brings viewers face-to-face with the extraordinary people of the past she unearths along the way.

name: Marblehead Manor
summary: The series concerned the goings on at the estate of the wealthy, eccentric Randolf Stonehill, heir to a corn oil fortune, and involved long suffering butler and head of the household staff Albert, who'd known Randolf when they were children; groundskeeper Rick who had eyes for maid Lupe; chauffeur Jerry; handyman Dwayne; and Randolf's materialistic, yet good hearted wife Hillary. Rounding out the cast was Lupe's mischievous son Elvis.

name: FIFA World Cup 2022 Highlights
summary: Football highlights from the competition held in Qatar.

name: You Must Be the Husband
summary: When his wife, Alice writes a best-selling novel, Tom should be a happy man. But life in the shadow of a successful spouse is not what Tom had in mind for his future.

name: Ramyeonator
summary: Kang Hodong goes to different places in Korea to make ramyeon.

name: She's the Sheriff
summary: "SHE'S THE SHERIFF, is a half-hour syndicated comedy series which stars Suzanne Somers as Hildy Granger, a mother of two who is appointed Sheriff of Lakes County, NV =~ the job her husband held before his untimely death.

name: Makeover by Monday
summary: Expert DIYer Jenni Yolo refreshes a space over the course of a weekend. Learn how she finds solutions for difficult spaces, works through the creative process, and brings the final product to life with a little help from her husband.

name: Bubbles
summary: Documentary series on underwater fauna and flora, created with over 48,000 minutes underwater. With its more than 200,000 kilometers around the world, the program team has recorded from the Costa Brava to the Yucatan, Micronesia and Indonesia.

name: Inspired Interiors with Sarah Sherman Samuel
summary: Having recently moved from Los Angeles to her home state of Michigan, designer Sarah Sherman Samuel creates beautiful homes for clients across the country. Each episode features a new project as Sarah balances work and family while designing amazing homes and furniture.

name: Royal Mob
summary: Through the lens of four young women - Princesses Victoria, Ella, Alix and Irene - this series lifts the lid on married life within each of the great Royal houses of Europe.

name: Fall for You
summary: A high-teen fantasy romance drama in which national idol Yoo Je Bi, who suffers from malicious comments, falls into romance novels and realizes the meaning of a new life.

name: Three Meals a Day - Sechs Kies
summary: Sechs Kies members meet up with Na Young Suk PD and Shin Hyo Jung PD, planning out their mini-variety program. The Sechs Kies members, who have never all lived together, will finally experience what it's like to live with their fellow group members, also preparing their own meals three times a day and carrying out various chores.

name: The Proof Is Out There: Bermuda Triangle Edition
summary: In this special edition series of The Proof Is Out There, Tony Harris travels to the Florida coast to explore the notorious and fear evoking Bermuda Triangle. Tony and a team of experts will analyze evidence of similar mysterious phenomena from around the world and render a verdict.

name: Unforgettable World Cups
summary: A look back at some of the most memorable moments from the FIFA World Cup and the Rugby World Cup, from the best teams to the best goals, shock results, fantastic players and everything in between.

name: Happy the Hoglet
summary: An animated series for preschool children. Happy is prickly, smelly and has fleas - life with his best friends has its ups and downs, but it is always full of laughs and adventure.

name: Choose
summary: Ton and Tawan love each other deeply but their love is tested by Ton's new secretary who seems to be the perfect match for him. Then Tawan starts acting distant and cold towards Ton, pushing him away.

name: Candy Color Paradox
summary: A change in the stakeout team throws Onoe, reporter for a weekly magazine, together with his contemporary, Kaburagi, a photographer. Onoe secretly considers Kaburagi his rival, and Kaburagi's haphazard way of doing things goes against Onoe's strong sense of ethics--there's nothing but conflict between them. But, in joint pursuit of a scandal, the two of them begin to care about each other...?

name: Oh! My Assistant
summary: Seon Heo is a graphic artist who specializes in creating adult webtoons for a living. In the course of looking for potential recruits, Seon Ho comes across a boy by the name of Mu Yeong, who he decides to hire as his assistant. However, there's just one thing: the moment Seon Ho lays his eyes on Mu Yeong, he finds himself immediately taken by Mu Yeong's cute yet irresistible charm. As the pair begin working together, sparks gradually spark between the boss and his assistant. But it appears that neither Seon Heo nor Mu Yeong have what it takes to confess their feelings for one another.

name: Happy Ending Romance
summary:
Cha Jung Woo might have had a bright future as a writer, had he not chosen to speak up against the corruption he witnessed among his seniors. Unfortunately, being unable to remain silent when faced with such unscrupulous behavior, Jung Woo chose to speak up, essentially ending his career before it even started. At least that's how things would have gone, had Kim Jung Hyun not chosen to stand beside him.

One of the literary world's brightest stars, Jung Hyun isn't afraid of Jung Woo's tarnished reputation. That being the case, Jung Hyun is more than a little wary when his young friend is approached by the highly successful publisher, Han Tae Young. Offering Jung Woo a chance to publish under his own name, Tae Young makes him an offer he can't refuse, but Jung Hyun isn't convinced Tae Young's motives are completely noble. 

Offering Tae Young a chance to publish one of his own works. Fueled by jealousy, Jung Hyun tries to keep Jung Woo away from the overly ambitious publisher; but no matter how hard he tries, Jung Woo can't seem to resist Tae Young's many charms. Torn between the writer he looks up to and the publisher he can't resist, where will Jung Woo's wavering heart land?

name: Forensic Heroes
summary: Tim Sir, Siu Yau, Sam, and Ding Ding are part of the Hong Kong police department that solves murder cases. Sam, the doctor on the team, meets a young girl named Mon, and tries to help her get her life back on track. Also an amateur author for crime novels, Sam shows Mon some of his work, which she ends up enjoying. One day, the police force is called to a very strange case. The murder victims have been killed in the same way the victims were in Sam's books. When the team begins to suspect Mon - they find her dead. Who is this strange serial killer and why are they killing people following Sam's books?

name: Blood and Heart: The Legendary Life of a Japanese Youth in China
Family Man
summary: A TV comedy writer and his wife deal with the tribulations of family life with her daughter and son by a previous marriage and their own 3-year-old girl.

name: Raising Miranda
summary: After his wife Bonnie leaves, Donald Marshack struggles to raise their teenaged daughter Miranda with occasional help from his friends the Hoodenpyles.

name: TV 101
summary: Recently divorced Kevin Keegan is a photo journalist who quits his job and returns to alma mater, Roosevelt High School, to teach journalism. He then teaches his class how to produce a television news program instead of a traditional school newspaper.

name: Rory Peck Awards
summary: The Rory Peck Awards celebrate the freelance cameramen and women who bring the world's stories to our screens.

previousepisode.name: Ramita Navai - Gaza: Doctors Under Attack

name: The All New Mickey Mouse Club
Unveiled: Surviving La Luz del Mundo
summary:
Unveiled: Surviving La Luz del Mundo explores the horrifying, yet relatively unknown story of the Christian church La Luz del Mundo (LLDM) and the sexual abuse that scores of members, many of them minors, say they have suffered at the hands of its successive leaders, known as the "Apostles". Told from the point of view of the survivors who met on Reddit to share their stories of abuse, the series chronicles the history of one of the most powerful religious groups not only in Mexico where it was founded, but also in the United States, while giving voice to the men and women who were brave enough to stand up and call out the heinous crimes.

Under the guise of the only true church offering eternal salvation, LLDM, which claims to have congregations in over 50 countries and over five million followers, was founded in 1926 by Aarón Joaquín González. Joaquín González was succeeded by his son and then grandson, all three Apostles said to be appointed by "divine revelation". Now, scores of former members have come forward to describe how the Apostles built and maintained a system to procure and groom children for abuse. The series culminates in the events leading up to the 2019 arrest of the current Apostle, Naasón Joaquín García and his present-day trial, shedding light on a story that was all but ignored by mainstream media, and illustrating the positive power of social media to unite and provide agency to the survivors.

name: Easy Abby
summary: Easy Abby is a web series about the anxieties, assumptions and passive aggressions of romance as seen through the eyes of Abby, a chronic seducer with an anxiety disorder who's just trying to get by. Our show features flawed charming sometimes neurotic characters. It's as much about the awkward as it is about the sexy.

name: Pop Paper City
summary: Pop Paper City is the capital of a captivating paper world where paper friends live.

name: Фанаты
summary: At first glance, the heroes of this program do not stand out from the crowd. Everything is as it should be for a man: work, family, friends and hobbies. But at some point, these ordinary guys turn into an aggressive pack with a special language, complex laws and their own cult - the cult of football.

name: Большой кэш
summary: Two teams of three compete for a large cash prize. Each participant will have to test their mettle: eating caterpillars, soaking in a bathtub full of snakes, picking up cockroaches with their bare hands, and shaving their heads bald. Viewers will experience a heady mix of excitement, fear, and surprises. And most importantly, they will see the savage lengths people are willing to go to win.

name: Flanders no Inu: Boku no Patrasche
Love Without Borders
summary: The series follows five Americans - Aaron Motacek, Danna Richards, Philip Michael Thomas Jr., Naeem Thompson and Gurleen Virk - who put it all on the line for love. All have come to the realization they're stuck in a rut and must change how they're looking for a mate as well as where they're looking. The love they long for and life they've always wanted could be waiting for them on the other side of the globe.

name: The Groovy Fellers
summary: Jools is out of work and down on his luck. He's sitting in a pub in Northumberland when a Martian walks in and starts up a conversation. The two set off on a journey around Britain, so that Jools can show the Martian what life is like on Earth.

name: I, Lovett
summary: A surreal sitcom in which Norman Lovett wanders through a world of his own creation, talking to dogs, spiders and inanimate objects.

name: Where Is Private Dulaney?
summary: In 1979, Private Leroy Dulaney vanishes from his post at Camp Lejeune. The Marine Corps say he went AWOL, but his mother Carol knows in her gut that something is wrong. Determined to find out what happened to her son, she undertakes her own investigation. She could have never imagined what she would uncover: a world of drugs, rumored satanic cults, and a possible serial killer.

name: Grim Tales
summary: Sitting in his age-old storytellers chair Rik Mayall reads, in his own unique and funny style, bizarre and exciting tales of gruesome giants, pompous princes and naughty princesses.

previousepisode.name: The Wolf and the Seven Little Kids

name: Los 8 de Irak
summary: A finales del año 2003 el Servicio Nacional de Inteligencia Español (CNI) vivía en Irak el momento más oscuro de su historia. El 29 de noviembre, ocho agentes son emboscados por sorpresa en Latifiya, víctimas de un violento tiroteo.

name: Brian Cox: How the Other Half Live
summary: The actor, famed for his role as formidable patriarch Logan Roy in the hit drama Succession, explores society's complicated relationship with money and wealth, and looks back at his own personal journey from growing up in poverty to becoming a Hollywood actor. Throughout the series, Brian spends time with people from all walks of life in a bid disentangle the link between money and happiness, from homeless people in the streets of Harlem to super models on Miami beach, and also addresses his own anger at the growing wealth gap which polarises the rich and the poor across the globe.

name: Our Brain
summary: Breakthroughs in brain imaging and genetics has made it possible to understand how the interplay of genes and environment affect the mind, and ultimately, tell us how to live better.

name: Open House
summary: Employees of a California real estate company compete for sales. Linda Phillips manages a L.A. real estate office and deals with her fellow realtors and Margo, her sassy, man-hungry receptionist.

name: Smith & Jones in Small Doses
summary: A series of sitcom playlets starring Mel Smith and Griff Rhys Jones.

name: Ma Mere
summary: Chantal, 58 ans, a reçu pendant son séjour en prison un diagnostic de trouble bipolaire. Elle se retrouve à la croisée des chemins et accepte pour la première fois sa vulnérabilité. Elle décide de jouer franc jeu avec sa famille qu'elle a malmenée.

name: Peaceable Kingdom
summary: Rebecca Cafferty, a recent widow from New York with three young children, accepts a job as the managing director of a large California zoo where her brother works.

name: Grails: When Sneakers Change the Game
summary: "Grails: When Sneakers Change the Game" follows the story of Eastside Golf and its quest to enter the world of sports fashion and sneaker culture. From humble beginnings to a deal with the top brand in the world, the founders of Eastside Golf look to create the ultimate and most sought-after shoes in the world – known in sneaker culture as "Grails."

name: Tales from the Zoo: Talking Animals
summary: The keepers, management and support staff at the Jersey Zoo give inside access of the zoo's operations as they dedicate themselves towards caring for the diverse assortment of animals that bring eager visitors every single day.
